statement: Duplicate and lost callbacks can replay without duplicate task transitions or external effects.
falsification_conditions: Any delivery id commits more than one task transition record in the durable journal.
Any effect key produces more than one record in the external effect sink.
A crash at any injected durability boundary leaves a transition without its queued effect, or an effect without the transition that authorised it.
A callback lost before its durable append is not replayable, or a callback whose acknowledgement was lost is applied a second time on redelivery.
A torn journal or sink frame is partially applied instead of truncated.
A worker displaced by a lease transfer commits under its expired fence.
A checkpoint sequence regresses, or a provider COMPLETED observation without a durable result commit is recorded as completion.
Repeated compilations of the replay report over the frozen fixtures are not byte-identical.
residual_risk: Support is established for the boundaries this harness can inject in a single Python process against a local filesystem store. It does not extend to a real network transport, a multi-process writer race, or a filesystem that reorders or discards fsync.
